roadmap: B1 associative 2D band (owner request 2026-10-30; first item after bounded 09)
scope: Band tool (M) picks two or more closed shapes in one sketch; Make band turns them into construction sources and stores {version, id, sources (side ids), offset?, width?} with no copied geometry; every evaluation path (part, previews/rings/middle, loft sections, DXF) regenerates the exact outer envelope (common tangent lines + wrap arcs; offset grows it, width makes a strip); refusals name the band; v1 rule: a band sketch holds only the band and its construction sources; construction shapes get side ids at Finish; bindings on sources/offset/width survive reopen; Extrude editor lists bindable band fields.

models.design: claude-opus-5-5 Plan sub-agent (frozen brief in design/brief.md, root-approved)
models.implementation: Sonnet sub-agents: model (A) and Studio (B) in parallel against a frozen API; audit fixes
models.rootEdits: reopen uses the resolved band; toggleBandPick stores the id-assigned shapes (run01 product defect) + test

geometry.algorithm: upper envelope of support functions h_i(θ)=c·u(θ)+ρ over each generator's normal cone, closed-form crossing angles; exact lines and arcs
geometry.checks: two circles vs openBeltLength (perimeter 1e-9 rel, area closed form, lines ⟂ radii ≤1e-12); 3 circles / circle+rectangle / circle+slot / polygons vs Cauchy integrals and a monotone-chain hull; audit oracle 5,634 random accepted bands (2–8 mixed sources, offsets, widths, ±8000 mm, ×1000 sizes) support-equal over 6,000 directions; 186 extruded volumes = area·h to 1e-6

model.mutants: audit 24/33 killed; the 6 real survivors now covered (reopen with bound offset/width, previews, DXF, ambiguous holder, tiny-arc collapse, tie check removed); 3 equivalent

docs.refusals: PASS (VALUE row lists the sketch directory)

audit.verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED, fixed in one round without re-audit (owner time concern)
findings: F1 medium: repeated-piece tags _0/_1 swapped under continuous rotation (start-dependent) -> named by the preceding source (b1_e1-e2), duplicates refused

F2 medium-low: false 'share part of their outline' refusals from a midpoint tie check on tiny intervals (1e-10..1e-7 noise) -> tie check removed (ties go to the lower source index; < 1e-12 rad intervals merged)
F3 low: picked shapes not highlighted (ids not stored) -> fixed by root after run01
F4 low: guided loft checked holes before resolving a band strip -> checked after
F5 low: malformed band files threw TypeErrors -> refusals
audit.accepted: construction shapes in existing sketches gain ids once on their next Finish (no downstream effect: construction is stripped before the kernel)

limits: v1: a band sketch holds only the band and its construction sources; sources must be convex; crossed/inner bands not supported
No agent/API band action (chat refuses profile 'band')
Make band / Remove band are undone only at document level, not with in-sketch Ctrl+Z
A topology change (a source starts/stops winning twice) renames or removes repeated-piece tags; references to a removed tag are refused, not rebound
Band offset/width bound to a parameter are edited in the feature editor, not the sketch panel
Superseded runs keep only their receipt
